State.name: Service Request Created
State.description: Request initiated by Customer with watch details

State.name: Service Request Accepted
State.description: Service Executive approved service with tentative price quote

State.name: In Transit
State.description: Customer dispatched watch with carrier tracking number

State.name: In Testing
State.description: Undergoing precision regulation, time duration, and complication feature testing

State.name: Transit Back
State.description: Servicing complete; watch dispatched back to customer

Transition.Description: Service Executive reviews diagnostic details, enters estimated cost, and accepts.
Service Executive declines service with explanation.
Customer ships watch and provides carrier and tracking info.
Package received at facility; watchmaker begins repair operations.
Repair complete; watch moved to testing for calibration.
Inspection passed; watch shipped back to customer with tracking number.
